title: Completed-master publishing review matrix

plan.objective: Create one cross-production publishing review matrix without authorizing upload, scheduling, account writes, or publication.
steps: Confirm each master and release-readiness record remains current.
Prepare platform metadata fields, thumbnail requirements, Made for Kids checks, accessibility decisions, vertical-derivative needs, and schedule fields.
Keep each project blocked until its own approvals are complete.
Record publication links only after explicit publication.
deliverables: Accessibility and Made for Kids checklist

findings.message: Big Surprise, Freeze Dance, and Colorful Day have current release-readiness control records.
A locked master or approved distribution authority does not authorize going live.

next_gate: Route the matrix to 04 — Publishing & Social Media for per-project metadata, thumbnail, accessibility, schedule, and publication decisions.
